about.lead: Videographer and cinematographer based in Mankato, Minnesota.
about.portraitAlt: Ayden Jenson, videographer and cinematographer based in Mankato, Minnesota
bio: I make brand films, commercials and social media content for businesses, along with photography.
I handle the planning, shooting, editing and color grading myself, which keeps the look consistent from start to finish.
I work with businesses in Mankato and beyond, and I'm open to travel. If you have a project in mind, I'd like to hear about it.

services.heading: Video Production in Mankato, MN
services.lead: Brand films, commercials and social media content for businesses in Mankato, MN and beyond, with photography to match.

items.title: Brand Films
items.summary: Story-driven films that show who you are, not just what you sell.
items.body: A brand film is the piece people watch when they want to know who they're dealing with. I plan it with you, shoot it on location and deliver a finished film for your website, your launch or your about page, along with shorter cuts you can post.

items.title: Commercials
items.summary: Short, sharp spots built for paid social, pre-roll and local TV.
items.body: Fifteen to sixty seconds with one clear idea. I handle concept, shooting, editing, color and sound, and deliver each spot in the sizes your ad platforms ask for.

items.title: Social Media
items.summary: Reels, TikToks and shorts shot and cut for the vertical screen.
items.body: One shoot day can cover weeks of posts. I shoot with your content calendar in mind and deliver vertical edits that are ready to publish, so your feed stays consistent without you having to film it yourself.

items.title: Photography
items.summary: People, event and branding photography that matches the look of your video.
items.body: Stills and motion from the same shoot keep everything you publish looking like it belongs together. Photography can be booked on its own or added to any video project.

process.title: Talk
process.text: A quick call or coffee to hear what you need, who it's for and where it will be seen.

process.title: Plan
process.text: I put together the concept, shot list and schedule so the shoot day runs smoothly.

process.title: Shoot
process.text: On location with a small, quiet setup that doesn't get in the way of your day.

process.title: Edit
process.text: Cut, color and sound, with a review round so you can ask for changes.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: Final files sized for every place you plan to post them.

services.areasText: Mankato, MN and beyond. Open to travel.

faq.q: How much does a video cost?
faq.a: It depends on the length, the number of shoot days and how the video will be used, so every project gets its own quote. Tell me what you have in mind and your budget range and I'll tell you what's possible.

faq.q: Do you work outside of Mankato?
faq.a: Yes. I'm based in Mankato, MN and open to travel for projects elsewhere.

faq.q: Can you make vertical videos for Instagram and TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. If the video is going on social, I frame for vertical on the shoot day instead of cropping it afterwards.
Yes. Photography can be booked on its own or added to a video shoot.
